cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  x.top_synsetid,
  x.top_cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.wordid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
) t
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = t.wordid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT c.wordid, c.synsetid AS top_synsetid, c.cnt AS top_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM senses s
    GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
  ) c
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c2.wordid, c2.synsetid
    FROM (
      SELECT s2.wordid, s2.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM senses s2
      GROUP BY s2.wordid, s2.synsetid
    ) c2
    WHERE c2.cnt > (SELECT MAX(c3.cnt) FROM (SELECT s3.wordid, s3.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM senses s3 GROUP BY s3.wordid, s3.synsetid) c3 WHERE c3.wordid = c2.wordid)
       OR (c2.cnt = (SELECT MAX(c4.cnt) FROM (SELECT s4.wordid, s4.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM senses s4 GROUP BY s4.wordid, s4.synsetid) c4 WHERE c4.wordid = c2.wordid)
           AND c2.synsetid = (SELECT MIN(c5.synsetid) FROM (SELECT s5.wordid, s5.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM senses s5 GROUP BY s5.wordid, s5.synsetid) c5 WHERE c5.wordid = c2.wordid AND c5.cnt = (SELECT MAX(c6.cnt) FROM (SELECT s6.wordid, s6.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM senses s6 GROUP BY s6.wordid, s6.synsetid) c6 WHERE c6.wordid = c2.wordid)))
  ) dup ON dup.wordid = c.wordid AND dup.synsetid = c.synsetid
  WHERE dup.synsetid IS NULL
) x ON x.wordid = t.wordid
ORDER BY t.total_senses DESC, t.total_synsets DESC, t.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
" > /tmp/fast_out.txt 2>/tmp/fast_err.txt; echo EXIT=$?; head -3 /tmp/fast_out.txt; wc -l /tmp/fast_out.txt; cat /tmp/fast_err.txt
